title: Lump-Sum Settlement Extension Allowance by Amount Still to Pay
content:
# Lump-Sum Settlement — Balance Allowance

**Rule.** For a due-date extension on an accepted Lump-Sum Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, the amount still to pay under the Lump-Sum Settlement is worked out from its ledger as the settlement amount booked on acceptance, less every settlement payment received, plus every settlement payment returned; where that amount still to pay is 500.00 dollars or more, the Lump-Sum balance allowance of 2 days is added; where it is at least 150.00 dollars but under 500.00 dollars, the Lump-Sum balance allowance is 1 day; an amount still to pay under 150.00 dollars carries no Lump-Sum balance allowance.

| Amount still to pay under the settlement | Balance allowance |
|---|---|
| 500.00 dollars or more | 2 days |
| 150.00 dollars up to 499.99 dollars | 1 day |
| under 150.00 dollars | none |

## Hypothetical ledger figures

| Booked on acceptance | Payments received | Payments returned | Amount still to pay | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 800.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 800.00 | 2 days |
| 800.00 | 800.00 | 800.00 | 800.00 | 2 days |
| 800.00 | 400.00 | 0.00 | 400.00 | 1 day |
| 600.00 | 460.00 | 0.00 | 140.00 | none |

## Edge figures

Exactly 500.00 dollars still to pay earns 2 days; 499.99 dollars earns 1 day; exactly 150.00 dollars earns 1 day; 149.99 dollars earns none.
